title: Faultwake Spire
description: A seven-metre violet blade growing up through a limestone fault with an uplifted bank and a downthrown bank.

review.notes: Round 3 (final). Fixed: base slabs no longer show wood-grain streaks; blade is darker violet; the top facet is no longer bluish; cracks are visible. Not fixed: (1) the main blade now bends like a banana/horn and ends in a slanted soft-edged cut, which weakens the prismatic silhouette instead of adding stepped growth. (2) Growth steps are still evenly spaced collar rings along the blade (bamboo). (3) closeup.jpg: flat low-poly facets with blurry horizontal glare bands, no lighter facet values per face, no internal bands; cracks are painted squiggle lines, not modelled. (4) Base slabs are now flat, untextured pale plates stacked like paper, with no rock structure at metre scale.
